label: Import raster
description: The raster2pgsql is a raster loader executable that loads GDAL supported raster formats into SQL suitable for loading into a PostGIS raster table. It is capable of loading folders of raster files as well as creating overviews of rasters.

parameterDescriptors.description: ssign output raster with specified SRID. If not provided or is zero, raster's metadata will be checked to determine an appropriate SRID.
parameterDescriptors.label: SRID

parameterDescriptors.description: Create a GiST index on the raster column.
parameterDescriptors.label: Create spatial index

parameterDescriptors.description: Apply raster constraints -- srid, pixelsize etc. to ensure raster is properly registered in raster_columns view.
parameterDescriptors.label: Use standard raster constraints

parameterDescriptors.description: Add a column with the name of the file
parameterDescriptors.label: Include a filename column

parameterDescriptors.description: Specify name of destination raster column, default is 'rast'
parameterDescriptors.label: Raster column

parameterDescriptors.description: Index (1-based) of band to extract from raster. For more than one band index, separate with comma (,). If unspecified, all bands of raster will be extracted
parameterDescriptors.label: Band index

parameterDescriptors.description: NODATA value to use on bands without a NODATA value.
parameterDescriptors.label: NODATA value

parameterDescriptors.description: Schema and table where to import the raster
parameterDescriptors.label: Schema and table

label: Import shapefile
description: The shp2pgsql data loader converts Shapefiles into SQL suitable for insertion into a PostGIS/PostgreSQL database either in geometry or geography format.

parameterDescriptors.description: Create a GiST index on the raster column.
parameterDescriptors.label: Create spatial index

parameterDescriptors.description: Creates a new table and populates it from the Shapefile.
parameterDescriptors.label: Create table

parameterDescriptors.description: Appends data from the Shapefile into the database table.
parameterDescriptors.label: Append to table

parameterDescriptors.description: Generate simple geometries instead of MULTI geometries.
parameterDescriptors.label: Simple geometries

parameterDescriptors.description: Use geography type instead of geometry (requires lon/lat data) in WGS84 long lat (SRID=4326)
parameterDescriptors.label: Use geography type

parameterDescriptors.description: Schema and table where to import the shape file
parameterDescriptors.label: Schema and table
